newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Chrysler to visit Manila for possible investments.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler to visit Manila for possible investments.

text.p: Officials of U.S. car giant Chrysler Corp will visit the Philippines on Thursday to look at investments prospects here, Board of Investments officials said on Tuesday.

Officials of the government agency declined to give details of the visit but BOI managing head Melito Salazar said Chrysler's planned project is unlikely to be as large as the plant of General Motors Corp.
In May, the Philippines lost to Thailand in the race to bag General Motor's Asian regional manufacturing plant which would cost about $500 million to $1.0 billion.
In January, Chrysler said it planned to set up a $130 million car manufacturing plant in the Philippines.
